docs.text:
A short, clear exposition (1916) by a Jain judge of the Jain doctrine of soul and matter, karma, the Tīrthaṅkaras, ethics and the Digambara and Śvetāmbara sects.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Outlines Of Jainism · Jagmanderlal Jaini · 1916, 198 scanned pages. Published 1916; Jagmanderlal Jaini died 1927 and his editor F. W. Thomas 1956; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
